Subtract 316 days from 1615-04-14.  
1615 is not a leap year (divisible by 100, not by 400).  
Days before April 14 in 1615: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + 14 days = 104 days.  
316 − 104 = 212 days into previous year (1614). 1614 is not leap. 212 days from Jan 1, 1614:  
Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 = 181 days. 212 − 181 = 31 days into July → 1614-07-31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1614-07-31
